Chaiyo! — logo ideas, round 2

Full word, always. Letterforms are outlined from system rounded fonts as SVG paths (concept sketches, not final custom lettering). Palette: paper / ink / Lantern Red + one soft accent, pale pink #f6e1db.

1Bubbly sticker

Chunky rounded letters hop on their own baseline, die-cut like a vinyl sticker with a white halo and ink edge.

2Hand marker

Felt-tip lettering on a pink highlighter stripe, red scribble underline: a note you wrote to yourself to cheer.

3Mochi squish

Inflated, soft-edged letters like mochi: pale pink body, blush shade, shiny highlight, a tiny face on the 'a'.

4Retro bounce

70s bounce: every letter tilts and jumps, red extruded shadow, speed lines behind. Loud and happy.

5Face-in-o

The 'o' is the cheerer: a red face with open mouth and blush, while the '!' shakes out little motion lines.

6Cheer banner

A wavy red ribbon-flag waving 'Chaiyo!' under a string of bunting: a cheer squad banner.
